data.labels: the world's exact position for every colour the public image shows; visible subset, 0-3 pairs; 288 validated examples; no mean-column bin
data.feedback: none in stage 1; stage 2 uses eight Adam feedback updates at lr 0.001 with allowance 32 and a zero-update control

read_scaffold.role: training-only per-slot head on object_z; never at evaluation
read_scaffold.matching: exact minimum over the 6 slot permutations

pilot_arms.A: full v2: anchor + two in-binding iterations + u_i content
pilot_arms.C: anchor disabled at query time, parameters kept and reported

criteria.pilot_gate_applies_to: arm A only; arms B and C are attribution arms and never gate the stop/go
criteria.early_stop: first dose set < 0.30 and pair < 0.60 -> binding_cannot_form_slots

stage2_gates.recovery: byte identical in an independent process

stop_conditions.pilot: any pilot gate fails -> binding_pilot_collapsed, do not run the full dose
stop_conditions.stage1: read gate fails at the final dose -> binding_partial, close the structure route
stop_conditions.knockout: zero effect on every scene -> read_ignores_slots, stop even if accuracy passes
stop_conditions.budget: any segment cap reached -> budget_stop, keep every checkpoint
stop_conditions.engineering: non-finite gradient, parent bundle mismatch, graph receipt mismatch, cache replay mismatch or cross-identity load -> engineering_failure

budget.rule: each segment cap may only be lowered after the price measurement; no transfer between segments
